question: How does PoolTogether v5 turn pooled deposits into prizes (TWAB, tiers, liquidation of yield), what is its scale on Base on 2026-10-08, and what other ROSCA or savings-game protocols exist?

frame.population: on-chain prize savings and ROSCA-like protocols

findings.finding: One Prize Pool per chain; vaults contribute prize tokens and a daily draw (drawPeriodSeconds) releases them. A winner is determined without a transaction by the winner: isWinner(vault, user, tier, prizeIndex) compares a pseudo-random number derived from (draw id, vault, user, tier, prize index) and the awarded random number against the user's time-weighted average balance share (from the TwabController) of the vault and the vault's share of contributions over the tier's look-back range. Anyone may then claimPrize for the winner and earn a claim fee from a decaying reward.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Every "Draw" a random number is provided and given to the Prize Pool and the next set of prizes are available.

findings.finding: Tiers: the pool computes the number of tiers (with a canary tier) from the previous draw's claim count; each tier has odds, the grand prize period is grandPrizePeriodDraws draws, and unclaimed tiers' liquidity rolls over; a reserve takes reserveShares of each draw and funds claim rewards. setDrawManager can be called once, by the creator only; awardDraw is restricted to the draw manager.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Sets the Draw Manager contract on the prize pool. Can only be called once by the creator.

findings.finding: Shutdown: if no draw is awarded within drawTimeout the pool can be shut down and depositors withdraw proportional shutdown balances (computeShutdownPortion, withdrawShutdownBalance). README: "Only WETH has been audited as the prizeToken for the prize pool."
Source last commit 2025-02-19 (prize pool), vault 2025-07-30, claimer 2024-07-16, draw manager 2024-07-16.

PrizeVault is an ERC-4626 vault (TwabERC20 shares, Claimable, ILiquidationSource, Ownable) over an underlying yield vault; deposit/mint record TWAB balances; yield above debt plus an immutable yieldBuffer is liquidatable: a LiquidationPair sells the yield for the prize token and sends it to the prize pool. Owner can set claimer, liquidation pair, yield fee percentage and recipient.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: contract PrizeVault is TwabERC20, Claimable, IERC4626, ILiquidationSource, Ownable

findings.finding: Principal is not at risk from the draw (a depositor can redeem at any time, which the TWAB then reflects); the risk is the underlying yield source and the vault owner's parameters.

item.title: DeFiLlama reads: PoolTogether v3, v4, v5

findings.finding: Parent pooltogether chain TVL on 2026-10-08: Ethereum 5,231,375; Optimism 1,507,033; Polygon 513,453; Base 408,782; World Chain 89,770; Celo 39,790; Gnosis 17,688; total 7,845,734 USD. Child listings: pooltogether-v5 2,276,243 (Optimism, Ethereum, Base, World Chain, Gnosis); v4 730,045; v3 4,839,447 (category Yield Lottery).

v1 game: divided into segments (weekly, monthly or other); players join in the first segment with a fixed amount (joinGame / joinWhitelistedGame); the stake is deposited to Aave (aDAI) on Ethereum or Moola on Celo; players must makeDeposit before each segment ends except the last, a "waiting round"; players who miss a deposit still get principal back but earn no interest; the interest is split among players who made every deposit; earlyWithdraw available with fees; admin withdraws performance fees. Variants: Polygon with Aave liquidity-mining MATIC rewards, Curve strategies.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Players that missed a deposit, still get their principal back after the end of the game, but do not earn any interest.

findings.finding: v2 adds deposit rounds of different length from the waiting round (hodl pools), flexible per-player deposit amounts up to a maximum, and interest accounting that weights time and amount of deposit.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Accounting of the interest and rewards distributed to winners considers time and amount of deposit

findings.finding: The organisation page is titled "HaloFi (prev. GoodGhosting)"; the archive portal is a "Community Legacy Support Portal" for HaloFi Challenges and HaloFi Save that "provides guidance for users to withdraw their funds via descentralized infrastructure", with the legacy site hosted at halofi.me "available till 20-Sep-2029" and on IPFS, and links a farewell post to the community. The docs list Dedaub as v2 auditor (core contracts and five yield strategies, 2022-06), Quantstamp for v1, and state no insurance is provided against unknown bugs.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Community Legacy Support Portal for HaloFi (prev. GoodGhosting) descentralized products

findings.finding: A ROSCA as a chit fund with auction: Phase 1 collection, where members deposit their full contribution as collateral until the pool is full; Phase 2 monthly auctions where members bid for the pot; the highest bidder, offering the largest discount, receives pot minus discount and the other members receive discount / (N-1) as immediate dividend; repeat until all have won. The README states a protocol fee under 1 percent and "Zero Default Risk: Phase I collection ensures full collateralization".
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Winner receives: Pot - Discount; Other members receive: Discount / (N-1) as immediate dividend

findings.finding: Savings circles ("Orbit") with a fixed contribution each cycle into a Soroban contract pool and automated rotation of the pot to one member by a predetermined or randomized sequence; written for the Philippine paluwagan.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: At the end of each cycle, the pooled funds are automatically disbursed to one member of the crew based on a pre-determined or randomized rotation sequence

findings.finding: A Bitcoin-native ROSCA on Lightning payments for Kenyan chamas: membership, loans and withdrawals need a 51 percent majority vote; automated payout to a saved Lightning address when the pool target is reached; proof of payment by payment hash. Not an EVM contract.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Membership, loans, and withdrawals require a majority vote to execute.

findings.finding: "Tanda coordinates a fixed rotating savings circle without holding its money": terms (name, amount, fixed turn order) in an invitation link, signed by members; each contribution goes straight from a member's wallet to the current recipient; no platform wallet, escrow, backend or database; the pot is rebuilt from memo-tagged Nimiq transaction history; 89 tests; running against the Nimiq testnet wallet.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Tanda does not have a platform wallet, escrow account, backend, or database.
